g.text: SD18 Finalize round 1 and open the supplement phase (Moderator)
[deadline passed but the scheduler has not locked the rooms yet]
SD16 Lock the rooms at the deadline
[not FORMING / deadline not passed / rooms below minimum /
[skipSupplement and students without a group remain]
In the SUPPLEMENT phase only Leaders of rooms below the maximum invite (SD11);
supplement invites never expire, and every accepted invite notifies the Moderator.
The Moderator can still add or move students (SD17).
